mentions.name: elm-test
mentions.description: Elm property-based testing library. Current work optimizes PBT generation and shrinking performance using JS TypedArrays, cutting a PBT-heavy test suite's runtime from 1336ms to 891ms, and experiments with adding coverage-guided, AFL-style PBT input generation on top of the library's existing random input generation.
mentions.problem: PBT generation and shrinking in elm-test were slow, and the library only supported random input generation with no coverage-guided input generation.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm optimizing performance of PBT generation and shrinking in [elm-test](https://github.com/elm-explorations/test/compare/master...janiczek-benchmark-js-randomrun) - on its own PBT-heavy test suite I got it down from 1336ms to 891ms by using JS TypedArrays.

I'm also experimenting with coverage-guided PBT input generation in the same library, AFL-style -- right now elm-test only has random input generation.
